templates.title: Comment templates
templates.explain: To tap in the song editor at “+ Comment” - for every device of the band.
templates.adminOnly: Only the band admin can change the templates.

master.title: Master control - {{band}}
master.explainDeviceText: exactly one device controls the show.
master.explainPersonText: every device of the person who is master (e.g. the band leader's tablet and phone) controls it together.
master.label: Master control
master.notSaved: Not saved - Stage server unreachable or no admin login on this device.
master.adminsOnly: . Only band admins can change that.

servers.none: None found - enter the address or scan the QR code.

pairing.title: Connect to this Stage server?

title: Band
removeLocalText: Remove “{{band}}” from this device? The band stays on the server - other devices are not affected, and you can rejoin any time.
deleteAllText: Songs, setlists, roster and dashboards are deleted on the Stage server - for every device, every member loses access. To remove the band from this device only, use the button below.
deleteLocalText: The band is on this device only - songs, setlists and roster will be lost.
adminOnlyMembers: Only the band admin can manage members.
localOnly: This band so far runs only locally on this device. As soon as a Stage server is there (e.g. at the next band meeting), “Connect” links this band to it - then every member can sign in on their own device with the “Invite” code above.
pinDigits: The PIN must have exactly 4 digits.
rolesKeepAdmin: Controls the visible widgets/dashboards. Only another admin can take your admin rights away.
rolesHint: Controls the visible widgets/dashboards - “Admin” manages the band
resetPinConfirm: Set a new PIN for “{{name}}”? The old one stops working at once.
lastAdmin: At least one admin must remain.
ownAdmin: Only another admin removes your own admin profile.
name: Name

inv.codeFailed: The code could not be loaded.
inv.title: Invite to the band
inv.founding: This is the only way back into this band if you ever lock yourself out - write it down, print it or save it as a PDF now. Scan the QR code or have the code entered - “Join band” on a new device.
inv.howTo: Scan the QR code or have the code entered - “Join band” on the new device. This code stays valid until a new one is made.
inv.address: Server address in the QR code: {{ip}}
inv.addressChange: If this address changes later, the QR code must be made again here - the code itself ({{code}}) stays valid.
inv.noAddress: The server address could not be found - the QR code only works with the camera in the app, not with a normal camera app.
inv.rotateConfirm: Make a new code? The old code then stops working - on every device that only knows it but hasn't joined yet.
inv.sheetText: StageBoard - invitation. On the new device choose “Join band” and scan the QR code or enter the code.
inv.sheetServer: Stage server: {{ip}} - if this address changes, print the QR code again (the code stays valid).
inv.sheetNoServer: Server address unknown - the QR code only works with the camera in the app.
inv.sheetValid: Valid until the code is made again in the app. Printed on {{date}}.

join.noServerId: This QR code holds no server identity - please enter the Stage server's address.
join.enterCode: Enter the band's code - ask the admin or scan the QR code.
join.title: Join band
join.intro: Scan the QR code from the band admin's device, or choose a band and enter its code.
join.installApp: Install the StageBoard app for Android
join.serverHint: Stage server: choose it from the network below, scan the QR code or enter the address.
join.cameraDenied: No camera access - choose the band below.
join.cameraHttps: The camera needs HTTPS - choose the band below.
join.pairFirst: Pair with a Stage server first (above) - then the bands appear here.
join.noBands: No band found on this Stage server.
join.moreBands: Further bands are created by a band admin: System → Band → “+ Band”. Then they invite you.
join.manualHint: Only for special cases - usually the QR code or band code is enough. The band admin has the details.

roster.intro: Enter the names of the other band members - as many as you like, one after another. Instrument/role and admin rights can be changed in the menu at any time.
roster.name: Name
roster.founder: You are founding {{band}}. Your name and a 4-digit PIN for your admin account - you can change the PIN in “Band” at any time.
roster.discardAsk: Discard “{{band}}” and start over (e.g. after a typo)?
roster.restart: Typed the band name wrong? Start over

pick.noLogin: No login - choose your profile from the band list.
pick.none: No profiles yet - an admin can create some in the menu.

err.notPaired: Not paired with a Stage server yet - search under System → Stage server or scan the band’s QR code.
err.noServer: Stage server not configured - joining not possible.
err.bandDeleted: This band was deleted on the Stage server and cannot be created again like this.
err.adminFounds: On this Stage server only a band admin can create new bands. Ask the admin of a band here to found the new band and then invite you.
err.provisionOffline: Stage server not reachable - the workspace could not be created.
err.connectFailed: Connecting to the Stage server failed.
err.deleteFailed: The band could not be deleted - Stage server not reachable or deleting failed.
err.settingFailed: Setting not saved - Stage server not reachable or no admin rights.
err.noLongerAdmin: This device is no longer an admin - action not possible.
err.renameFailed: The band could not be renamed - Stage server not reachable.
err.memberCreateFailed: The member could not be created - Stage server not reachable.
err.lastAdmin: At least one admin must remain.
err.adminChangeFailed: Admin status could not be changed - Stage server not reachable.
err.memberRemoveFailed: The member could not be removed - Stage server not reachable.
err.onlyAdminCode: Only admin accounts have a reset code.
err.resetFailed: The password could not be reset - Stage server not reachable.
err.offline: Stage server not reachable - check the network connection and the Stage server address, then try again.
err.wrongCurrent: Current password wrong, or this device is no longer an admin.
err.pinDigits: The PIN must have exactly 4 digits.
err.pinServer: The PIN could not be set (server error) - please try again.
err.pinParse: The PIN could not be set (unexpected server answer) - please try again.
err.codeFailed: The code could not be renewed - Stage server not reachable.
err.listServer: Bands could not be loaded (server error) - please try again.
err.listParse: Bands could not be loaded (unexpected server answer).
err.pinCheckServer: The PIN could not be checked - error on the Stage server.
err.pinCheckOffline: The PIN could not be checked - Stage server not reachable.
err.proofRejected: Admin proof rejected - switching not possible.
err.switchFailedAny: Switching failed - Stage server not reachable or an error.
err.switchOffline: Switching failed - Stage server not reachable.
err.joinServer: Joining failed (server error) - please try again.
err.joinParse: Joining failed (unexpected server answer) - please try again.
err.switchServer: Switching failed (server error) - please try again.
err.switchParse: Switching failed (unexpected server answer) - please try again.
err.lockout: Too many wrong PINs - this admin is temporarily locked.
